title: Round-1 coordination: remote claim refs not pushed; exclusive file ownership in one PI session
question: How are ECDLP-1..4 claimed when this Claude Code cloud session is authorized to push only to branch claude/exciting-mccarthy-yljzor?
rationale: docs/CONCURRENCY.md requires refs/heads/claims/TSK on origin. The session git policy forbids pushing other branches without explicit user permission, so remote claim refs were NOT created. All round-1 work runs inside one PI session; subagents own disjoint files (their own RUN json/md) and do not commit. Independence between subagents is instructed (do not read sibling RUN reports) but not technically enforced, since they share one checkout.
claims: No cross-clone exclusivity guarantee exists for ECDLP-1..4 in this session; a concurrent Codex session could duplicate work.
next_action: User may authorize pushing claims/* refs; otherwise a future session with that permission should claim open tasks before execution. Check for duplicate work on merge.
notes: Recorded by PI RUN-62dbda7c. Branch named in the session instructions (claude/exciting-mccarthy-yljzor) supersedes CLAUDE.md branch name codex/ecdlp-research-laboratory for this session.
